mentions.name: Tricot
mentions.description: A 3D pixel art tool for painting pixel art directly onto low poly 3D models. Supports FBX import and export, and a save system with a version control feature is in development.
mentions.problem: Painting pixel art directly on 3D models was complicated in existing software tools like Blender or Autodesk; the author just wanted to paint pixels on 3D characters.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have been working on a pixel art tool... but in 3d. Basically painting pixel art directly on your low poly models.

http://tricot.studio
